'''Scent tongues''' were [[Ssi-ruu]]vi sensory organs. Located in each nostril, the scent tongue gave each individual olfactory senses beyond the [[Human/Legends|Human]] range, as well as being capable of detecting someone's stress level at the slightest touch.
